items.en: A tiny knowledge base that cites its notes
lead: 三张固定纸条。你选一个问题，页面只从对上的那张纸条里取句子。这不是联网模型，也不要密钥。
Three fixed notes. You pick a question, and the page takes a sentence only from the note that matches. This is not a live model call, and it asks for no key.
input: 纸条 A：班车 7:40 从东门发车。纸条 B：会议室在 3 楼，钥匙在前台。纸条 C：周五不开放打印机。
Note A: the shuttle leaves the east gate at 7:40. Note B: the meeting room is on floor 3, and the key is at the front desk. Note C: the printer is closed on Friday.
steps: 选一个问题。对得上的问题会标出纸条编号。
Pick a question. A question that matches names the note.
看回答。回答后面跟着那张纸条的原句。
Read the answer. The note’s own sentence follows it.
expect: 问“班车几点从东门发车？”，回答是 7:40，依据纸条 A 的原句。
Ask “What time does the shuttle leave the east gate?”. The answer is 7:40, from the sentence on note A.
fail: 问“食堂今天有什么菜？”。三张纸条都没有这一句，页面就说没有，不另编一句。
Ask “What is on the cafeteria menu today?”. None of the three notes says it, so the page says so and does not invent a sentence.
code: 程序员可以把 match 函数展开。它只是按问题编号取纸条，没有向量，也没有请求。
Programmers can open the match function. It picks a note by the question id. There is no vector and no request.

items.en: An assistant that asks you before it acts
lead: 一件固定的事：把草稿发出去。助手先把要做的动作念出来，等你点头。这不是联网模型，也不要密钥。
One fixed job: send a draft. The assistant reads the action out and waits for you. This is not a live model call, and it asks for no key.
input: 任务：把草稿《周会纪要》发给项目组。助手准备做的动作：发送一封邮件，收件人是项目组，标题是周会纪要。
Task: send the draft “Weekly notes” to the project group. The action it is about to take: send a mail, to the project group, titled Weekly notes.
steps: 读任务和它准备做的动作。
Read the task and the action it is about to take.
点“先问我”。它会停下来问要不要发。
Tap “Ask me first”. It stops and asks whether to send.
点头之后才出现“已发出”。点取消就停在未发送。
“Sent” appears only after you agree. Cancel leaves it unsent.
expect: 先出现问题“要发给项目组吗？”，此时还没有“已发出”。点头之后才有“已发出（样本）”。
The question “Send it to the project group?” appears first, and “Sent” is not there yet. “Sent (sample)” appears only after you agree.
fail: 点“不问就发”。页面会标出：这一步没有问你就把样本标成已发出。这是失败的那条路。
Tap “Send without asking”. The page marks that this path labeled the sample sent without asking you. That path is the failure.
code: 程序员可以展开 decide。它只看你点的按钮，不调用接口。
Programmers can open decide. It only looks at the button you tapped. It calls no API.

items.zh: 带着测试结果改一处错误
items.en: Change one mistake and see the tests
lead: 一条写在页面上的计价规则，和两道会当场算的测试。你选一种改法，页面用同一套期望重算。这不是联网模型，也不要密钥，也不需要 Python。

A fare rule written on the page, and two tests that run here. You pick a change, and the page recomputes the same expected numbers. This is not a live model call, it asks for no key, and it does not need Python.
input: 规则：起步 1 公里 3 元，之后每公里 2 元。现在的算法把每一公里都按 2 元算。测试：1 公里应为 3，3 公里应为 7。
Rule: 3 yuan for the first kilometre, then 2 yuan for each kilometre after that. The current code charges 2 yuan for every kilometre. Tests: 1 km should be 3, and 3 km should be 7.
steps: 看两道测试现在的结果。两道都是红的。
Look at the two tests as they stand. Both are red.
Pick “Change it to match the rule”. The page recomputes.
两道都变成对的，才算这一份做完。
Both turning green is the finished result.
expect: 按规则改之后，1 公里得到 3，3 公里得到 7。两道都对。
After the change that matches the rule, 1 km gives 3 and 3 km gives 7. Both pass.
fail: 选“每一公里都按 3 元”。1 公里碰巧是 3，3 公里得到 9，不是 7。第二道仍然是错的。
Pick “3 yuan for every kilometre”. 1 km happens to be 3, and 3 km gives 9, not 7. The second test stays wrong.
code: 程序员可以展开 fare。三种算法都写在页面里，测试就是对这两个输入算期望。
Programmers can open fare. All three formulas are on the page. The tests compare those two inputs with the expected numbers.
